task: [Project: Cobalt/data-svc] Set the PostgreSQL connection pool size for Cobalt's data-svc.

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Cobalt] data-svc connection pool is set to 20 connections; Cobalt's DB server has max_connections=200 and hosts 8 services.
[Project: Cobalt] Pool size is configured via DB_POOL_SIZE in data-svc/config/production.yaml; pgbouncer is not in use for data-svc.
[Project: Helios] data-svc pool size is 50 connections; Helios has a dedicated DB instance with max_connections=500.
candidate_memories.notes: note: scope=Helios; dedicated DB allows larger pool

candidate_memories.content: [General] Connection pool size should be (core_count * 2) + effective_spindle_count as a starting point; tune down from there.
candidate_memories.notes: note: general formula, Cobalt-specific value is authoritative

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Cobalt / legacy] Old pool size was 50; reduced to 20 after DB connection exhaustion incident in 2024.
candidate_memories.notes: stale: incident context, current value is 20 as in p1

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Cobalt] DB server CPU is at 45%; no signs of connection pressure currently.
